resources.string: Quill uses accessibility to detect the text field you are focused on and to insert your dictated text into it. It reads the focused field only to position and place dictation, and never reads or writes password or banking fields. Quill does not collect your data or send it to any server we operate.

To type your dictation into whatever app you are using, Quill needs the Accessibility service.

What it does:
• Detects which text field is focused, so your words go to the right place.
• Inserts the transcribed text at your cursor.

What it never does:
• It does not read or write password or banking fields.
• It does not collect your data or send it to any server we operate. Audio goes only to the speech provider whose API key you supply.

You can turn this off any time in Settings.
